body.purpose: Compact menus, labels, and editable property values.

narrative.overview:
The user’s direction is “Blender meets the early 2000s.” Treat the editor as a serious native modeling tool: compact task workspaces, linked editing areas, cool steel-gray controls, and a dark graphite viewport. Use the amber accent as a single clear signal for active tools, selected objects, and focused editing states.

The interface favors direct access to the scene, properties, and timeline over decorative framing. Beveled borders and dark panel title bands establish depth; the viewport stays visually distinct from the light editing surfaces. Keep the controls dense, tactile, and legible, with square corners and immediate state changes.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, resizable work areas around a large 3D viewport.
Cool steel-gray chrome around a graphite canvas.
Amber marks selection and active editing state.
Raised buttons, inset fields, crisp borders, and square corners.
Tahoma at 12px for the general interface; no decorative motion.

rules.name: The One Amber Signal Rule
rules.body: Use amber for a current selection or active state. Do not turn it into a general decoration color.

rules.name: The Bevel Is the Depth Rule
rules.body: Use light and dark border edges to distinguish raised and inset hardware; do not add ambient card shadows.

dos: Do keep the viewport, Outliner, Properties, and Timeline visually distinct and directly accessible.
Do use amber only for an active tool, selected object, focus state, or splitter hover.
Do preserve bevel direction so raised buttons and inset fields read differently.
Do keep every transform value and Properties tab visible at compact pane widths.
Do use the real scene and real editing state in previews.
donts: Don't add glass, ambient shadows, rounded cards, or decorative texture to the editor chrome.
Don't use amber as a background decoration or as a substitute for timeline key colors.
Don't hide controls behind horizontal scrolling when the pane can be compacted.
Don't imply unsupported modeling or export features through the visual language.

components.name: Raised Button
components.description: Standard action control with a tactile raised and pressed state.
components.css: .ds-button-raised { background: #C5C9CA; color: #1B2025; border-top: 1px solid #F0F1EF; border-left: 1px solid #F0F1EF; border-right: 1px solid #737B82; border-bottom: 1px solid #737B82; padding: 4px 9px; min-height: 18px; font: 12px Tahoma, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; } .ds-button-raised:hover { background: #D7D9D8; } .ds-button-raised:active { background: #B9BDBE; border-top-color: #737B82; border-left-color: #737B82; border-right-color: #F0F1EF; border-bottom-color: #F0F1EF; } .ds-button-raised:focus-visible { border: 1px solid #9A5018; outline: none; } .ds-button-raised:disabled { color: #555D63; background: #B6BABB; }

components.name: Inset Field
components.description: Editable text and numeric values on an inset pale surface.
components.css: .ds-input-inset { background: #E1E3E2; color: #171B20; border-top: 1px solid #727A80; border-left: 1px solid #727A80; border-right: 1px solid #F2F3F2; border-bottom: 1px solid #F2F3F2; padding: 3px 4px; font: 12px Tahoma, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; } .ds-input-inset:focus-visible { border: 1px solid #B86820; outline: none; } .ds-input-inset:disabled { color: #555D63; background: #B6BABB; }

components.name: Workspace Rail
components.description: Five task tabs on a dark steel rail, with a distinct active workspace.
components.css: .ds-workspace-rail { display: flex; gap: 0; background: #3C444C; padding: 0; } .ds-workspace-tab { background: #737C84; color: #F5F5F2; border-top: 1px solid #AEB4B8; border-left: 1px solid #858E96; border-right: 1px solid #4B545D; border-bottom: 1px solid #282F35; padding: 6px 15px 5px; margin: 2px 1px 0; min-width: 48px; font: 12px Tahoma, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; } .ds-workspace-tab:hover { background: #89929A; } .ds-workspace-tab-active { background: #C6C9C9; color: #171B20; border-top: 3px solid #E28B3E; border-bottom-color: #C6C9C9; padding-top: 4px; font-weight: bold; } .ds-workspace-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #9A5018; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Area Header
components.description: Compact title band for a resizable editor area.
components.html: Outliner
components.css: .ds-area-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 21px; padding: 1px 2px 1px 6px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #68737D, #505A64 45%, #414A53); border-top: 1px solid #929BA2; border-bottom: 1px solid #262D33; color: #F2F3F2; font: 700 12px Tahoma, sans-serif; } .ds-area-header strong { flex: 1; } .ds-area-control { background: #626D77; color: #F2F3F2; border-top: 1px solid #89939A; border-left: 1px solid #89939A; border-right: 1px solid #30383F; border-bottom: 1px solid #30383F; min-width: 19px; min-height: 17px; padding: 0 2px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-area-control:hover { background: #77838D; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-area-control:active { background: #3D464E; }

components.name: Selected Scene Row
components.description: Amber highlight for the current object or bone in the Outliner.
components.css: .ds-selected-row { background: #D98435; color: #171B20; padding: 1px 3px; min-height: 20px; font: 12px Tahoma, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Timeline Key Marker
components.description: Diamond markers show keyframes; color differences encode timeline state.
components.css: .ds-timeline-keys { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; min-height: 24px; background: #3A3A3A; } .ds-key { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: #5AC8FF; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%); } .ds-key-selected { background: #FF9628; } .ds-playhead { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 35%; width: 1px; background: #E64646; }
